question: What numbers of vessels or deities are prescribed in the nine and twenty-five configurations?
premises: Eight is specified in relation to the configurations.
A configuration of nine is mentioned.
A configuration of twenty-five is mentioned.
inference: Therefore there should be eight in the nine-number configuration and in the twenty-five-number configuration.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the number eight depends on the ritual context of the surrounding verses.
plain_english: There should be eight in the arrangement of nine and in the arrangement of twenty-five.
